variants.label: File Upload
variants.tooltip: Allows users to upload files to the Gateway from a Perspective Session.

enabled.description: Whether or not the control is enabled.

maxUploads.description: The maximum amount of simultaneous uploads.

supportedFileTypes.description: A list of the file types that the control will allow. If nothing is specified, all file types are allowed.

fileSizeLimit.description: The maximum file size in MB (per file) that a user can upload.

path.description: Shorthand path to icon source, in format: library/iconName

library.description: Optional alternative to 'path', name of library where icon is located. Must also supply 'name'.

name.description: Optional alternative to 'path', name of icon. Must also supply 'library'.

oneOf.description: Color of the icon. Here for convenience, may instead assign 'fill' in the styles prop.

enabled.description: Color of the icon when parent component is enabled.

disabled.description: Color of the icon when parent component is disabled.

events.name: onFileReceived
events.description: Fired after the gateway has received a file upload.

name.description: The name of the uploaded file.

size.description: The size (in bytes) of the file that was uploaded.

events.name: onUploadsCleared
events.description: This event is fired when the user has cleared all uploads after the uploads have completed.

files.description: A list of completed uploads. Each object in the list will have the following attributes:

name.description: The name of the uploaded file.

size.description: The size (in bytes) of the file that was uploaded.
